author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before had small wheels with heavy frame bars sitting on top of them, and neither the post nor the fork reached the hubs as in the reference; redrawn with large r8 wheels, a straight post from the rear hub through the rim to the saddle, top tube, and a fork from the front hub through the rim to a curled handlebar.
omissions: Handlebar curls forward instead of back so it keeps 8 units from the saddle.
